question: CKQR is related to FITP in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, WERN is related to ZCUL. To which of the following options is BOLJ related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed079e56f511f2b5119275a9e92435a276e76a0481cf64928e701f0f5d0e1235.png] 

The logic followed here is:

CKQR is related to FITP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad42bd190cd0cfd6e4a0c5fd91babf03488247c4e1e0d81fb4f49c35ec3c5aeb.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d1d46cd5d696a6eecbab8f80433bd7cd712d4ab9c45b184279b6f19789b2edc.png] 

WERN is related to ZCUL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bffb7917f9d161d6a4ad25dff067f37c32e3a1f9262cfdcacb55186d665590c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e82ee1c13e84d4a33713bcba02e02fddf8dad6df1a20a452b13df72408f0ba6b.png] 

Similarly,

BOLJ is related to

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a07e5706017a42d1fc87bb7cdf7640ddbcfe4b8819d8d3566ee564fb92d903f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c1971fe4cc5214ce687e0374f67495b796e0f44635fdfea6d6c056cbaed4ee1.png] 

Thus, **EMOH is related to BOLJ.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
